changes: Tornado Atlas reads the Data sheet, keeps the case label, recorded date, start and end time, geocoded position and EF value, and leaves out the time notes, the Chinese and English locations and both damage description columns. Clock times stored as spreadsheet fractions of a day are shown as hours and minutes. This is not a publication of the dataset's authors or an endorsement by them.

coverage.count_basis: Source cases in version 2 of the dataset, not a complete count of physical storms.

limits: Each position is the dataset authors' geocoded point for a place description, not a survey position or a path. A date range gives the approximate dates of occurrence, not a duration. Times are UTC+8 as recorded and are not converted. The dataset says its place names, time notes and damage descriptions come from the Yearbook of Meteorological Disasters in China, whose terms are not read, so they are not shown. Cases are source records, not a complete count of tornadoes in China.
